{{{{{1|Monster Infobox}}} |title = Sand Scorpion |images = Sand Scorpion Anim.gif |location = [[Crimson Badlands]] |drops = ''See loot table'' |hp = 80 |dmg = 100 - 120 |def = 1 |speed = 3 - 6 |XP = 5 - 15 }} ''{{PAGENAME}}'' is a type of [[Monsters|Monster]] found in the [[Crimson Badlands]] that spawn in groups. How many spawn depends on [[Configuration Options]] chosen. * Default: ~150 max spawn per day * ChallengingBadlands: ~240 max spawn per day * LowMemoryBadlands: 45 max spawn per day ==Strategy== {{PAGENAME}} exhibits the same behavior as a Wilderness Golem or Iridium Golem. It burrows up through the ground and aggressively follows and attacks the player. Sand Scorpions rarely appear as a single enemy, usually appearing from a den in a mob. {{Note|For clarity on vanilla behavior and strategy, see [[Stardew:Wilderness Golem|Stardew Valley Wiki - Wilderness Golem]].}} ==Loot Drops== {{LootDropsTable|Title=Sand Scorpion}} | rowspan="2" | [[Crimson Badlands]] | {{NameSDV|Bug Meat}} || 1 - 2 |- | {{Name|Void Pebble}} || 1 |} {{clear}}
